history.text: The Takrur state on the Senegal River adopted Islam early.
Jolof and its successor kingdoms ruled the interior.
Portuguese navigators reached the coast; Goree later became a trading post.
Independence came on 4 April, with Leopold Sedar Senghor as first president.
A first change of governing party through the ballot box.
